term.title: reaction path

definitions.text: A synonym for mechanism.A trajectory on the potential-energy surface.A sequence of synthetic steps.
sources: PAC, 1994, 66, 1077. 'Glossary of terms used in physical organic chemistry (IUPAC Recommendations 1994)' on page 1159 (https://doi.org/10.1351/pac199466051077)
